description: This file implements the TurnTraceObserver class, which integrates with OpenTelemetry to create and manage trace spans for conversation turns within a larger application. It tracks start and end events for turns and conversations, creating hierarchical tracing spans for detailed observation of conversation flows.

classes.name: TurnTraceObserver
classes.description: An observer class that creates and manages OpenTelemetry tracing spans for each conversation turn, supporting hierarchical tracing within conversations.

methods.name: __init__( self, turn_tracker: TurnTrackingObserver, conversation_id: Optional[str] = None, additional_span_attributes: Optional[dict] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Initializes the TurnTraceObserver with a turn tracker, optional conversation ID, and additional span attributes, setting up event handlers for turn start/end.

methods.name: on_push_frame(self, data: FramePushed)
methods.description: Placeholder method to process incoming frames, does not modify the data.

methods.name: start_conversation_tracing(self, conversation_id: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Starts a new conversation span, creating span attributes and setting context.

methods.name: end_conversation_tracing(self)
methods.description: Ends the current conversation span and any active turn span, cleaning up contexts.

methods.name: _handle_turn_started(self, turn_number: int)
methods.description: Creates a new span for each turn, setting relevant attributes and updating context.

methods.name: _handle_turn_ended(self, turn_number: int, duration: float, was_interrupted: bool)
methods.description: Ends the current turn's span, recording duration and interruption status.

methods.name: Optional["SpanContext"] get_current_turn_context(self)
methods.description: Returns the span context of the current turn for use by external services.

methods.name: Optional["SpanContext"] get_turn_context(self, turn_number: int)
methods.description: Returns stored span context for a specific turn number.
